integrity: Universal assertions have an elementary proof; finite exhaustive tests through n=12 are corroboration only. Historical novelty is supported by source comparison, not independently certified.
limitations: Only the rank-two and rank-(n−1) Green strata for n≥4 are classified. No global involution is asserted, and historical equivalence is not ruled out.
title: Idempotent-fixing inverse involutions on the extreme Green strata of isotone monoids
